messages:
alex: Heads-up — kicking off a quick sync about ChainForge/AgentFlow gateway pilot & marketplace packaging. Goal: validate end-to-end connector, SSO, and listing mechanics. Need test matrix, SOW, and joint announce window. :wave:

maria: +1. Are we targeting GCP Marketplace and Azure first, or start with AWS only?

devon: I'd recommend AWS + GCP initial. Azure requires extra certs for their marketplace tile.

sarah: For the gateway connector: auth layers to cover — OAuth + mTLS for private deployments. Also need schema for operator config.

jules: Partner ask: ChainForge wants a demo harness and perf numbers (p50/p95 latency) on our Dedicated config. Can we run a 2-hour soak on a 4xA100 pool?

alex: Good call. @devon can you schedule the soak and provide perf dashboard link? We should capture token costs as well.

devon: Yes — I'll spin up a job. ETA tomorrow morning. Will share Grafana link and a brief runbook.

maria: On marketplace packaging: draft of the manifest looks like:
```
name: chainforge-gateway
publisher: Redwood Inference
plans:
  - name: basic
    metrics: tokens
```
Need legal sign-off on TOU before submit.

sarah: For SI/integration checklist: SSO, billing mapping, observability hooks, sample app, upgrade matrix. I'll drop a checklist in the repo.

partner-bot: New partner SOW template created: https://internal.redwood/sow-templates/partner-sow-v2

jules: Announcement timing — ChainForge prefers late-April. That aligns with our release window if we do canary rollout this week.

alex: Action items:
- devon: run soak + share perf (due: tomorrow)
- sarah: add SI checklist & sample app (due: 3 days)
- maria: start marketplace manifest + legal ping (due: 2 days)
- jules: draft joint PR/comms (due: 5 days)

alex: I'll reconcile the calendar and set a short 20-min sync after perf results. :calendar:

maria: ack :thumbsup:

devon: started the job — logs here: https://ci.redwood/jobs/7654

jules: noted — prepping press outline.

sarah: uploading checklist to repo now.

alex: thanks everyone — we’ll sync after perf. :rocket:
